topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I've seen it all, from the stoic silence of streets at dawn to the late-night clamor of dive bars. But this, this is something. Found the old gal’s engagement ring at Joe's Pawn, wrapped in decades of lies and whispers. The lady, she was teary-eyed, fingers trembling as she held that tarnished band. Told me stories of her grandmother, of love and times long passed. The shop owner gave me a sidelong glance, but I saw it. The truth, as always, hiding in plain sight. Didn’t take much to get him to part with it, a few quiet words about family and honor. The lady left with that ring, and a piece of her past reclaimed. Some things, you just can’t put a price on.
